vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

From ضَحْوَة (ḍaḥwa, “morning”), from the root ض ح و (ḍ ḥ w). Sense of “become” resembles other verbs of similar meaning derived from different times of day; compare أَصْبَحَ (ʔaṣbaḥa), بَاتَ (bāta), أَمْسَى (ʔamsā), all meaning "become."
From بَيْنَ (bayna, “between”) + لَيْلَة (layla, “night”) + و (w, “ and”) + ضُحَا (ḍuḥā, “forenoon”) + هَا (hā, “its”), Literally, “between one night and its [following] morning”.
From root ض ح و (ḍ ḥ w), though often written as ضُحًى (ḍuḥan), as if deriving from ض ح ي (ḍ ḥ y). Compare زِنًى (zinan) for a reverse situation.
